hook: Did You Know Deleted Files Aren't Actually Gone? 🗑️
headline: Deleting a File on Your Computer Does Not Actually Erase It

slides.speaker: vr
slides.title: Deleted Files? 😳
slides.bubble: Wait, when I delete a file, it's really gone forever?

slides.speaker: vj
slides.title: The Truth! 💡
slides.bubble: Not quite! Emptying your trash just hides the file's location.

slides.speaker: vr
slides.title: Bytes Remain! 💾
slides.bubble: So the actual data stays on my drive until overwritten?

slides.speaker: vj
slides.title: Recoverable Data? 🤔
slides.bubble: Exactly! Data recovery is possible. What do you think about this?

takeaway: Emptying the trash only deletes the pointer in the directory index. The actual bytes remain on your hard drive until overwritten, allowing data recovery.
caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

Did You Know Deleted Files Aren't Actually Gone? 🗑️

💡 Emptying the trash only deletes the pointer in the directory index. The actual bytes remain on your hard drive until overwritten, allowing data recovery.
